# Target sum T = 1810
# Sequence B: 11 elements equal to 91, 9 elements equal to 90.
# Total sum S = 11*91 + 9*90 = 1001 + 810 = 1811.

X = [91] * 11 + [90] * 9
n = len(X)
T = 1810

# Generate all subset sums
subset_sums = {0}
for x in X:
    new_sums = set()
    for s in subset_sums:
        new_sums.add(s + x)
    subset_sums.update(new_sums)

# Find the minimal distance to 1810
min_distance = float('inf')
for s in subset_sums:
    distance = abs(s - T)
    min_distance = min(min_distance, distance)

print(f"Sequence B: {X}")
print(f"Total Sum: {sum(X)}")
print(f"Minimal distance to 1810: {min_distance}")
